title: frc-vision-scorer whole-event scouting export
description: One FRC event's vision-scouting data: a header, one row per analysed match (TBA lineup + phase timestamps on the match video), the matches that could not be used, and one envelope per scouting metric. Produced by GET /api/scouting/{event_key}/export. This schema describes top-level schema_version 3, envelope schema_version 1, timeline_version 1 and robots_version 3. Every object may gain new keys in later releases without a version bump: importers must ignore keys they do not know. Human guide: README.md next to this file.

schema.description: File-type tag. Always this string for the whole-event export (single metric envelopes use 'frc-vision-scorer.scouting').

schema_version.description: Version of the whole-file layout (header + cameras + matches + skipped + envelopes). Bumped on a breaking change to this layout. v2 added the header and matches[]; v3 (additive only) added camera_legend, cameras, matches[].cameras / unidentified_s / unidentified, path cams / camera_s and robot identity / identity_s.

matches.description: One row per match that has a usable replay, in play order (qm, then ef, qf, sf, f; by set_number, then match_number). Matches listed in skipped[] are not here. Each carries robots[] (whole-match robot paths) unless the export was made with paths=false.

skipped.description: Matches that have a replay but could not be used (no data from them appears anywhere in the file). Matches with no replay at all are simply absent.

envelopes.description: One envelope per scouting metric that applies to this season, in a fixed order (2026: shift_heatmap, auto_paths, movement, cycles, defense, bump_stuck). Discriminate on envelope.metric, never on position. An unknown metric key must be skipped, not treated as an error.

path_frame.description: Coordinate frame of matches[].robots[].path. Absent when the export was made with paths=false.

camera_legend.description: Camera names in bit order for every cams bitmask in the file: bit i (value 1 << i) = camera_legend[i]. Always starts main, corner_left, corner_right; other cameras follow, sorted. Absent when the export was made with paths=false.

cameras.description: Calibration details of every camera version that matches[].cameras references, keyed by camera name, then version_id. Present with and without paths.

eventKey.description: The Blue Alliance event key, e.g. '2026cur' (2026 Curie division).

year.description: FRC season year (selects the game, field size and rules).

timestamp.description: When this file (or envelope) was generated, ISO-8601 UTC with an explicit +00:00 offset, whole seconds, e.g. '2026-11-20T23:04:11+00:00'.

matchKey.description: The Blue Alliance match key: '<event_key>_<comp_level><set>m<match>' for playoffs ('2026cur_sf4m1', '2026cur_f1m2') or '<event_key>_qm<n>' for qualifications.

compLevel.description: TBA comp_level: qm = qualification, ef = eighth-final, qf = quarter-final, sf = semi-final (2023+ double-elimination rounds), f = final.

alliance.description: Alliance colour the team played on in this match. null = unknown (not produced for lineup teams in practice).

station.description: Driver station 1..3 in TBA order (TBA alliances[*].team_keys index + 1; RoboRecon alliancePosition). null = unknown (not produced for lineup teams in practice).

teamKey.description: A team number as a decimal string (JSON object keys must be strings), e.g. '3128'.

sourceRef.description: Which replay (pipeline run) a match's data came from.

set_number.description: TBA set_number: 1 for every qualification match; the series number in playoffs (sf4m1 -> 4).

match_number.description: TBA match_number: the qualification number (qm8 -> 8); in playoffs the game within the set (sf4m1 -> 1, f1m2 -> 2).

replay_id.description: Opaque id (a UUID) of the vision-pipeline replay used for this match. Changes when the match is re-analysed; use it to detect that data changed.

replay_created_at.description: When that replay was created, ISO-8601 WITHOUT a timezone (the analysis server's local clock), e.g. '2026-11-20T12:07:32'. Informational only. null if unknown.

legacy_labels.description: true = the replay predates the pipeline's window-label identity stage, so robot->team attribution is less reliable. Treat its team data with caution.

match.description: One analysed match: TBA identity + lineup and the phase timestamps on its video.

alliances.description: TBA lineup. Each array is [station 1, station 2, station 3] team numbers; an entry is null when TBA does not list a team in that station.

timeline.description: Phase timestamps on the match's source video, or null when the replay has no usable match clock / frame rate.

robots_version.description: Version of robots[] / unidentified[] / their path columns and the top-level path_frame + camera_legend. Bumped on a breaking change to them (v2 was additive: cams, camera_s, identity, identity_s, unidentified; v3 was additive: per-point det_conf / tracker_prob columns and the per-track conf summary). Absent with paths=false.

auto_s.description: Match seconds of auto (2026: 20). Path times t < auto_s are auto, later ones teleop. Absent with paths=false.

robots.description: Every robot of the match: lineup order (red 1-3, blue 1-3), then any identified team the lineup does not list. Absent with paths=false.

cameras.description: The calibration version each camera used in this match, keyed by camera name (main, corner_left, corner_right, ...). A camera missing here was not used. Present with and without paths.

unidentified_s.description: Robot-seconds of tracked robots never matched to a team, per period. Present with and without paths.

unidentified.description: Tracked robots we never named: one entry per contiguous piece of one slot, by slot then time. Absent with paths=false.

lineupRow.description: Team numbers in driver-station order 1, 2, 3 (null = no team listed).

skippedMatch.description: A match whose replay could not be used.

replay_id.description: The replay that was rejected (absent when the replay's files could not be read at all).

reason.description: Human-readable reason, e.g. 'no match clock (summary.periods)' or 'no readable meta.json'.

timeline.description: Where each match phase sits in the SOURCE VIDEO (the TBA/YouTube match video file the pipeline analysed). All times are video seconds = frame / video.fps, measured from the first frame of that file. Boundaries are fitted from the on-screen match clock minus a 0.5 s display lag; accuracy about +-0.25 s (match_start from the scoreboard start indicator is frame-accurate). Durations are VIDEO seconds, not rule lengths: the broadcast clock runs ~1% slow against the video, so teleop typically spans ~141.5 s of video, not 140.

timeline_version.description: Version of the timeline block. Bumped on a breaking change to its shape or meaning.

marks.description: Instants in the video. Auto marks (match_start, auto_end) and teleop marks (teleop_start, endgame_start, match_end) each come as a group: an auto-only replay has only the auto pair; a replay with no auto period has only the teleop three.

endgame_start.description: Endgame starts (teleop countdown reaches the season's endgame value: 30 s in 2026, 20 s in 2024-2025).

phases.description: Intervals between marks, sorted by start_s (a parent phase before the sub-phases that start with it). Top-level phases: auto, between (the auto->teleop pause), teleop. Sub-phases carry within='teleop': 2026 transition, shift1..shift4, endgame; other seasons endgame only. A phase is present only when both of its bounding marks are.

timelineVideo.description: The video the times refer to.

fps.description: Frames per second used to convert frame <-> seconds (the file's average frame rate, rounded to 4 decimals). Often not exactly 60 (59.94, 59.716, ...): always use this value, never assume 30/60.

fps_source.description: 'video' = read from the source file (ffprobe). 'clock_estimate' = no video file was available; fps estimated from clock-scan frame counts (within ~2%), so times are less exact, and frame_count / duration_s are null.

frame_count.description: Frames in the source file, or null if unknown.

duration_s.description: Length of the source file in seconds, or null if unknown.

youtube_key.description: YouTube video id of the TBA match video (the same footage, so the same video seconds), or null if TBA lists none.

youtube_url.description: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<youtube_key>&t=<N>s with N = floor(match_start.t), i.e. opens at the match start (to the whole second). null without youtube_key or match_start.

mark.description: One instant in the source video.

t.description: Video seconds from the start of the file (3 decimals). Clamped at 0.

frame.description: round(t * video.fps): the frame index (0-based) in the source file.

video_time.description: t formatted M:SS.ss for humans, e.g. '2:21.25'.

source.description: How the value was measured. 'indicator' = frame where the scoreboard start indicator lights (frame-accurate, match_start only). 'clock_ticks(N)' = fitted from N on-screen clock ticks near this boundary, minus the 0.5 s display lag (~+-0.25 s). 'clock_offset' / 'true_start_frame' = pipeline start estimate. 'clock_lead' = fallback from the clock scan's first-sample frame (~+-0.5 s). '<method>+<N>s' = derived as another mark's value + N seconds of rule time (when no local clock fit was possible).

phase.description: One interval of the source video.
Phase name. Known values: auto, between, teleop; within teleop: transition, shift1, shift2, shift3, shift4 (2026 hub shifts), endgame.

start_s.description: Start, video seconds (equals the bounding mark's t).

duration_s.description: end_s - start_s in VIDEO seconds (not the rule length; teleop ~141.5, auto ~20.1, between ~4.0, shifts ~25.25).

within.description: Present only on sub-phases: the parent phase this interval lies inside. Absent on top-level phases.

frame.description: Coordinate frame of the envelope's positions.

field_m.description: [length L along x, width W along y] of the field in metres (2026: [16.541, 8.069]).

perspective.description: ALLIANCE PERSPECTIVE: x = 0 is the team's own alliance wall, +x toward the opponent wall, so a team's red and blue matches overlay. Blue positions equal WPILib field coordinates; red ones are transformed by the field symmetry. Exceptions documented per field: auto_paths points_field and bump_stuck bumps are absolute WPILib field coordinates.

symmetry.description: How red is mapped into alliance perspective. rotational (2025, 2026): (x, y) -> (L - x, W - y). mirror (2023, 2024): (x, y) -> (L - x, y).

matchHead.description: Common header of every per-match row inside a team entry.

envelope.description: One metric's results for the whole event. The base keys below are common to every metric; metric-specific keys (teams payload and extras) are described in the then-branches, selected by 'metric'. Unknown metrics validate against the base only.

schema_version.description: Version of the envelope's common keys. Bumped on a breaking change to them.

metric.description: Metric key; the discriminator for the payload. Known: shift_heatmap, auto_paths, movement, cycles, defense, bump_stuck.

metric_version.description: Version of this metric's payload (teams + extras). Bumped on any breaking change to it.

params.description: The metric's tuning parameters used for this run (name -> number / boolean). Recorded for reproducibility; the defaults unless someone overrode them.

sources.description: The replays this metric was computed from (same set as the top-level matches[], ordered by match_key string, NOT play order).

teams.description: Per-team results keyed by team number as a string. Includes every team in any analysed match's TBA lineup (even if never seen by the cameras).

teamBase.description: Common part of every team entry.

team_number.description: FRC team number (same as the key).

rankingExtras.description: Extras shared by the ranking metrics (movement, cycles, defense, bump_stuck).

ranking.description: Every team key in rank order (best first); unrankable teams (rank null) last, by team number.

score_key.description: The team-entry field the ranking sorts on (larger = higher rank).

legend.description: Human-readable explanation of the metric with the actual parameter values.

rankingTeam.description: Keys shared by team entries of the ranking metrics.

n_matches.description: Analysed matches with this team in the lineup.

n_counted.description: Matches with enough valid tracking (>= params.min_tracked_s seconds in the metric's scope) to count toward the averages.

low_data.description: true when n_counted < params.min_matches; the team is still ranked but its numbers are unreliable.

coverage.description: Tracked seconds over all n_matches / (expected seconds per match x n_matches); null when n_matches is 0.

rank.description: 1-based rank on score_key (1 = largest). null = unrankable (no counted data).

rankingRow.description: Keys shared by per-match rows of the ranking metrics.

counted.description: Whether this match counts toward the team's averages (enough valid tracking).

coverage.description: Valid tracked seconds / expected seconds for the metric's scope in one match (0..1).

heatBucket.description: One team's time in one shift bucket (for one station split).

seconds.description: Total labelled robot-seconds in this bucket.

cells.description: Sparse heatmap, only non-zero cells, sorted by (ix, iy). Each entry [ix, iy, seconds]: cell column ix = floor(ax / grid.cell_m) (0..grid.nx-1, x in alliance perspective), row iy = floor(ay / grid.cell_m) (0..grid.ny-1), seconds spent there. Cell centre = ((ix + 0.5) * cell_m, (iy + 0.5) * cell_m).

summary.description: Time-weighted summary of the bucket. All fields except n_samples are null when there are no samples.

own_zone_frac.description: Share of the time in the team's own ALLIANCE ZONE (ax <= zones.own_max_x).

neutral_zone_frac.description: Share of the time between the two alliance zones.

opp_zone_frac.description: Share of the time in the opponent's ALLIANCE ZONE (ax >= zones.opp_min_x).

n_samples.description: Position samples (~0.2 s each) behind this bucket.

n_matches.description: Analysed matches with this team in the lineup.

matches.description: One row per match, play order.

auto_winner.description: Alliance that scored more FUEL in auto (from TBA); decides which shifts the team's hub was active. null = tie or no TBA data: shifts 1-4 go to bucket 'unknown'.

seconds.description: Labelled seconds of this team in each bucket in this match.

matches_by_station.description: Matches played from each driver station, keys '1', '2', '3' (always all three).

by_station.description: Heatmaps per station split: 'all' (every match) plus '1'..'3' for each station the team played. Each value maps bucket -> heatBucket.

coverage.description: Per bucket: labelled seconds (by_station.all) / seconds the team could have been seen in that bucket over its matches. null when nothing was expected (e.g. 'unknown' when every match had a known auto winner). Low coverage = sparse map, not a robot that sat still.

shiftHeatmapEnvelope.description: metric = shift_heatmap (2026 only): where each robot spends time per 2026 REBUILT hub shift.

nx.description: Columns along x = ceil(L / cell_m) (34 for 2026); the last column extends past the far wall.

ny.description: Rows along y = ceil(W / cell_m) (17 for 2026).

zones.description: Zone bounds used by heatBucket.summary, alliance-perspective x in metres.

own_max_x.description: Own ALLIANCE ZONE is ax <= this (2026: 4.029).

opp_min_x.description: Opponent ALLIANCE ZONE is ax >= this (2026: 12.512).

buckets.description: All bucket names: auto, transition, active, inactive, endgame, unknown. active/inactive = the team's own hub is active/inactive during shifts 1-4.

default_buckets.description: Buckets the source UI shows by default (active, inactive, endgame).

station_layout.description: Drawing hint only: where each driver station sits along the alliance wall in alliance-perspective y ('high' / 'mid' / 'low'). NOT verified against the game manual; the data itself is split by TBA station number.

auto_winner_by_match.description: match_key -> 'red' | 'blue' | null (tie / no TBA data) for every analysed match.

autoPathRow.description: One team's autonomous path in one match. Rows exist for every lineup match even without a path (n_samples 0, empty arrays).

source.description: Where the path came from: 'autonomous_paths' = the pipeline's slot-continuous smoothed auto track, attributed to the team by majority label; 'frames' = rebuilt from per-frame team labels; null = no path.

coverage.description: Share of the auto period actually seen (0.25 s grid, gaps <= params.max_gap_s bridged); inserted points do not count.

label_share.description: Share of the slot's auto labels naming this team (attribution confidence). null without a path.

runner_up_share.description: Share of the most common OTHER team label on that slot. null without a path.

identity_conflict.description: runner_up_share >= 0.25: the path may be partly another robot.

n_samples.description: OBSERVED samples before field rules. points[] can be longer (inserted start / detour points) - use points.length to iterate.

start_check.description: 2026 starting-line check: ok = first point on the start line; inferred = first point reachable from the line, a start point on the line was inserted at t=0 (or replaced the t=0 point); unseen = first point later than params.start_window_s, start unknown; violation = cannot have started on the line (very likely another robot: listed but never clustered); null = no path or field rules off.

start_offset_m.description: Distance from the first point to the nearest legal start, metres; null when start_check is unseen / null.

n_clamped.description: Observed points moved out of an obstacle (hub base / trench blocks).

n_detour.description: Points inserted to route a segment around an obstacle.

cluster.description: id of the team's routine cluster this path belongs to (see clusters[]); null = not clustered (no path, coverage < params.min_coverage, or start violation).

mirrored.description: true = this path is the left/right reflection (ay -> W - ay) of its cluster's representative (same routine run from the other side). null when cluster is null.

points.description: [t, ax, ay] per point: t = seconds since auto start on the game clock (0..20 in 2026, rounded to 0.01), ax/ay = ALLIANCE-PERSPECTIVE metres (rounded to 0.01). Time-sorted.

points_norm.description: [ax / L, ay / W] per point (same order as points, no time): 0..1 of the full field in alliance perspective, 4 decimals. Matches RoboRecon PathValue stroke points.

points_field.description: [t, x, y] per point in ABSOLUTE WPILib field metres (blue wall at x = 0): where the robot really drove, e.g. to draw red autos on the red side. Equals points for blue.

point_kinds.description: One letter per point: s = seen (observed), c = clamped (observed, pushed out of an obstacle), d = detour (inserted to route around an obstacle), i = inferred start (inserted on the start line).

autoCluster.description: A repeated auto routine: paths whose time-aligned mean distance (mirror-aware) is within params.threshold_m (average-linkage clustering).

id.description: Cluster id within this team (0 = most frequent). Referenced by autoPathRow.cluster.

members.description: Match keys of the member paths, play order.

representative.description: The medoid path's match key (draw this one as 'the routine').

mean_spread_m.description: Mean pairwise path distance inside the cluster, metres (0 for a single path).

n_mirrored.description: Members that are reflections of the representative.

start.description: Median first point [ax, ay] (alliance perspective, in the representative's orientation).

duration_s.description: Median seen span of the member paths, seconds.

n_matches.description: Analysed matches with this team in the lineup.

n_with_path.description: Of those, matches with at least one observed point.

matches.description: One row per match, play order.

autoPathsEnvelope.description: metric = auto_paths (any season): each team's autonomous path per match, grouped into routines.

legend.description: Display hints, e.g. {perspective: 'own alliance wall at x=0'}.

movementSummary.description: Pooled movement numbers over the team's counted matches. Every field is null when there is no speed-known time.

moving_s_per_match.description: Seconds moving (smoothed speed >= params.move_speed_mps) per counted match, raw (shrinks with low coverage).

stationary_s_per_match.description: Seconds stationary per counted match, raw.

avg_speed_mps.description: Average speed over all speed-known time (stationary counts as 0) = moving_frac x mean_moving_mps, m/s. The rank score.

speed_known_s.description: Total seconds with a defined speed (moving + stationary), all counted matches.

movementTeam.description: movement team entry (whole match = auto + teleop; teleop-only alongside).

tracked_s_per_match.description: Valid tracked seconds per counted match.

max_sustained_mps.description: Typical top speed: median over counted matches of the highest speed held for params.sustain_s, m/s.

max_sustained_best_mps.description: Best single-match value of that, m/s.

teleop.description: The same summary over teleop only.

matches.description: One row per match, play order.

items.description: movement per-match row. The moving/stationary keys are present only when counted is true.

held_s.description: Seconds of stalled (bit-identical repeated) tracking positions in this match.

avg_speed_mps.description: Average speed over speed-known time, m/s.

max_sustained_mps.description: Highest speed held for params.sustain_s in this match, m/s.

movementEnvelope.description: metric = movement (2026): seconds moving vs stationary and speed, ranked on avg_speed_mps.

event_stats.description: Data-quality totals over the whole event.

held_kept_s.description: Held seconds kept as stationary (robot was still there when tracking resumed).

implausible_speed_samples.description: Samples whose speed exceeded params.max_speed_mps (label jumps) and were set unknown.

cyclesTeam.description: cycles team entry (neutral zone -> own alliance zone trips).

cycles_per_min.description: Teleop cycles per tracked teleop minute, pooled over counted matches. The rank score.

cycles_teleop_per_match.description: Teleop cycles per counted match (raw: undercounts with low coverage).

teleop_tracked_s_per_match.description: Valid tracked teleop seconds per counted match.

mean_cycle_s.description: Mean cycle time (neutral entry to next neutral entry), seconds.

mean_neutral_visit_s.description: Mean dwell per neutral-zone visit, seconds.

mean_own_visit_s.description: Mean dwell per own-zone visit, seconds.

resets.description: Tracking gaps > params.max_gap_s that reset the zone state machine (counted matches).

matches.description: One row per match, play order.

teleop_tracked_s.description: Valid tracked teleop seconds (coverage = this / 140 in 2026).

cycles_teleop.description: Completed neutral -> own trips in teleop.

cycles_per_min.description: cycles_teleop per tracked teleop minute; null with no teleop tracking.

cycle_return_times.description: Game-clock seconds since auto start (auto 0..20, teleop 20..160 in 2026, pause removed) at which each cycle's own-zone return began, auto and teleop cycles together.

cyclesEnvelope.description: metric = cycles (2026): neutral-zone -> own-alliance-zone trips (collect, come home to shoot), ranked on cycles_per_min.

zones.description: State-machine zone bounds, alliance-perspective x in metres.

defenseTeam.description: defense team entry (teleop time on the opponent's side).

opp_side_frac.description: Share of tracked teleop time with ax >= zones.opp_min_x, pooled over counted matches. The rank score.

opp_side_s_norm.description: opp_side_frac x 140 s: what a fully tracked match would show.

matches_long.description: Counted matches with >= params.long_visit_s seconds there.

teleop_tracked_s_per_match.description: Valid tracked teleop seconds per counted match.

by_station.description: Split by alliance + station, keys like 'red1', 'blue3' (counted matches only; only splits the team played).

matches.description: One row per match, play order.

opp_side_s.description: Teleop seconds on the opponent's side.

opp_side_frac.description: opp_side_s / teleop_tracked_s; null with no teleop tracking.

defenseEnvelope.description: metric = defense (2026): teleop time in or near the opponent's alliance zone (a defense proxy), ranked on opp_side_frac.

opp_min_x.description: 'Opponent side' = alliance-perspective ax >= this, metres (L - alliance zone depth - params.near_m; 2026: 11.512).

bumpEpisode.description: A stretch stopped on one bump (for finding it in the video; does not drive the ranking).

t_start.description: Game-clock seconds since auto start (auto 0..20, teleop 20..160 in 2026, pause removed).

remaining_at_start.description: Countdown within that period at the start, seconds (what the on-screen clock showed).

duration_s.description: Wall span of the episode, seconds.

stopped_s.description: Seconds actually observed stopped on the bump within it.

bump.description: Which bump, from the team's side: own / opponent half, left / right as seen from its own driver station.

bump_field_side.description: Which alliance's half of the field the bump is on (absolute).

counted.description: Whether the episode's match counts toward the team's numbers.

bumpStuckTeam.description: bump_stuck team entry (time stopped on a bump, 'beached').

stuck_s_total.description: Seconds stopped on a bump over counted matches.

matches_with_episode.description: Counted matches with at least one episode.

matches_stuck.description: Counted matches with >= 1 s stopped on a bump.

stuck_s_per_match.description: stuck_s_total / n_counted. The rank score (larger = more often beached).

tracked_s_per_match.description: Valid tracked seconds per counted match.

episode_list.description: All episodes (counted and not), play order then t_start.

matches.description: One row per match, play order.

stuck_s.description: Seconds stopped on any bump in this match.

bumpStuckEnvelope.description: metric = bump_stuck (2026): time stopped on a bump, ranked on stuck_s_per_match.

bumps.description: The four bump rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1] in ABSOLUTE WPILib field metres (blue wall at x = 0), not alliance perspective.

pathFrame.description: Frame of the robot paths: absolute WPILib field coordinates (NOT the metrics' alliance perspective).

field_m.description: [length, width] of the field in metres.

perspective.description: Origin at the blue alliance wall's right corner (seen from the blue driver station), +x toward the red wall, +y to the left; the same for both alliances.

robot.description: One robot of a match and its whole-match path.

alliance_position.description: TBA station 1..3; null when the lineup does not list the team.

identity.description: How this team's label was decided: every stretch of a tracker slot labelled with this team (neighbouring rows of one slot with the same source merged), by slot then start_frame. Team numbers are read ONLY from the main camera.

identity_s.description: Match-clock seconds of identity[] by source (a null source counts as 'unknown').

robotPath.description: Where the robot was over the whole match. t/x/y/frame/cams are parallel arrays of length n_points, sorted by t, one point per analysed frame where the robot was located AND identified as this team.

seen_s.description: Seconds the robot was located, per period.

auto_source.description: autonomous_paths = auto points from the pipeline's slot-continuous auto track; frames = from labelled frames; null = no auto points.

auto_label_share.description: Share of the auto track's team readings naming this team (autonomous_paths only).

confirmed_share.description: Share of labelled frames whose team number was read directly.

segments.description: [first, last] index ranges (inclusive) safe to draw as one polyline: split where points are > 1.0 s apart or a step is faster than 7 m/s.

n_jumps.description: Segment breaks caused by a step faster than 7 m/s (label jumped robots / bad position).

t.description: Match seconds: auto 0..auto_s, teleop auto_s.. (the auto->teleop pause removed).

frame.description: Source-video frame; video seconds = frame / timeline.video.fps.

confColumn.description: robots_version 3. Per point, the robot detector's (YOLO) box confidence for the detection behind that point, 0..1. null for a coasting point (no measurement), a point inside a SAM-propagated window with no detection that frame, a replay recorded before this field existed, or wherever unknown.

trackerProbColumn.description: robots_version 3. Per point, the SAM3 per-object tracker confidence of the mask behind that point, 0..1. Only set inside SAM-propagated windows (most points are detector-only and null); also null for coasting points, older replays, or wherever unknown.

confSummary.description: robots_version 3. Summary of the det_conf / tracker_prob columns over this track's points, skipping nulls. Means/minimums are null when no point has a value.

camsColumn.description: Per point, a bitmask of the cameras that saw the robot in that frame: bit i (value 1 << i) = camera_legend[i]. 0 = no camera saw it: the tracker was coasting and the position is a prediction. A null item = no camera log for that frame. The whole column is null when the analysis kept no per-frame camera log.

cameraSeconds.description: Seconds of the points each camera saw, keyed by camera name, plus 'none' (coasting). A point counts toward every camera in its mask; each point stands for the time to the next point, capped at one frame period. null when cams is null.

identityRow.description: One stretch of one tracker slot labelled with this team.

slot.description: Tracker slot (R1..R3, B1..B3): a tracker seat, not a station.

start_t.description: Match seconds of start_frame; null outside the match clock.

end_t.description: Match seconds of end_frame; null outside the match clock.

source.description: window_digits (number read from the bumper digits), window_lineup (matched against a lineup card of the match's teams), window_fill (carried along the track, no read), window_elim (the alliance's only unlabelled team, no read); older analyses: read, stitched, none, null. Treat unknown values as data.

read_camera.description: main for window_digits / window_lineup (reads only ever use the main camera); null otherwise.

score.description: Confidence 0..1 (frame-weighted mean over merged rows), or null.

confirmed.description: true = the number was read directly.

unidentified.description: One contiguous piece of one slot that was tracked but never matched to a team (split like robot path segments: > 1.0 s gap or a step faster than 7 m/s). team_before / team_after / candidates are HINTS, not proof: a slot can be re-seeded onto another robot.

track_id.description: '<slot>#<n>', n = 1-based piece index within the slot in time order. Stable for one replay_id.

duration_s.description: Seconds the points stand for (time to the next point, capped at one frame period).

team_before.description: Team labelled on the same slot in the nearest labelled frame before the piece.

gap_before_s.description: Match seconds from that frame to first_t.

team_after.description: Team labelled on the same slot in the nearest labelled frame after the piece.

gap_after_s.description: Match seconds from last_t to that frame.

candidates.description: The alliance's lineup teams NOT labelled on another slot in at least 50% of the piece's frames, in station order. Empty when the lineup is unknown (or all three were labelled elsewhere).

cameraUse.description: Which calibration a camera used in one match.

status.description: 'main' for the main camera; for a corner camera the per-match check's verdict: kept, adopted, dropped (not used for this match), failed_kept, or a future value.

cameraError.description: A calibration version whose file could not be read.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 local time, no timezone ('' or null for the legacy file).

start_match.description: First match the version was made for (TBA key), or null.

rejected.description: An operator rejected this version later.

mode.description: pinhole (OpenCV pinhole + distortion), camera (fisheye), homography (ground-plane mapping, no pose).

crop_region.description: [x, y, w, h] of this camera inside the composite broadcast frame.

rms_error_px.description: Reprojection RMS of the solve, pixels.

intrinsics.description: Pixels; K is the 3x3 camera matrix.

model.description: fisheye_kb4 = OpenCV fisheye k1..k4 (mode camera); opencv_pinhole = OpenCV k1, k2, p1, p2, k3, ... (mode pinhole).

edge_shift_px.description: Max |distorted - ideal pinhole pixel| at the mid-left and mid-right image edges; null if it can't be computed.

corner_shift_px.description: The same at the four image corners; null if it can't be computed (e.g. a wide fisheye whose corners lie past 90 degrees).

pose.description: Camera pose in the WPILib field frame (path_frame, z up). null in homography mode.

position_m.description: Camera centre [x, y, z] in field metres (= -R^T t).

yaw_deg.description: Heading of the optical axis in the field XY plane, atan2(dir_y, dir_x): 0 = toward +x (red wall), counter-clockwise from above positive.

pitch_deg.description: Elevation of the optical axis; negative = looking down.

roll_deg.description: Rotation about the optical axis: 0 = image up as close to world up as possible; positive = camera turned clockwise seen from behind (scene appears turned counter-clockwise).

rotation_matrix.description: R, field -> camera (OpenCV: p_cam = R X_field + t; camera x right, y down, z forward).

homography.description: 3x3 image -> field ground-plane matrix in homography mode, else null.
